//private: Must be true to use npm workspaces — prevents accidental publish of the monorepo root

scripts.//dev: Starts backend and frontend in parallel using concurrently — single command for full-stack dev
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.//start: Runs the compiled backend server (requires a prior 'npm run build')
scripts.//test: Runs both workspace test suites in parallel via concurrently
scripts.test: concurrently "npm run test -w backend" "npm run test -w frontend"
scripts.//lint: Explicit --config avoids a jiti auto-discovery issue where the root tsconfig.json causes a TypeScript project-service conflict with workspace tsconfigs
